question: I'm a level 9 Wizard with 20 Intelligence. I want to cast Fireball at a group of enemies 120 feet away. What is the spell save DC, what saving throw do the targets make, and how much damage do they take on a failed save?
expected_answer: Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus (+4 at level 9) + Intelligence modifier (+5) = 17. Targets make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 8d6 fire damage (average 28). On a success, half damage. Fireball has a range of 150 feet, so 120 feet is within range.

bm25_simple.answer: DC 17 (8+4+5). Dexterity saving throw. 8d6 Fire damage on failed save, half on success. Range 150 ft, 120 ft is within range. Upcast: +1d6 per slot above 3rd.
